content: CVE-2025-49825 Teleport (<17.5.2) critical auth bypass: Teleport logic accepted an SSH certificate as a valid signer (only CA keys should be), combined with x/crypto/ssh IsUserAuthority/IsHostAuthority accepting certs as CA keys; user certs could sign further certs. Led to NCC audit of x/crypto/ssh with 9+ CVEs (2026). Lesson: never accept certificates as CA keys (draft-miller-ssh-cert: MUST NOT).
